plain: The finding that a model's error falls in a smooth, predictable way as you add parameters, data and compute.
eli5: The bigger the brain and the more books it reads, the smarter it gets, at a steady, predictable pace.
technical: An empirical power law relating test loss to model size N, data D and compute C (Kaplan et al. 2020); Chinchilla (Hoffmann et al. 2022) set the compute-optimal ratio near 20 training tokens per parameter.
